name: pi-branch-context
description: Keeps LLM work scoped to the current git branch: injects a branch scope context file (.pi/branches/.md) into the prompt and gates out-of-scope implementation work behind a blocking user choice dialog.

metadata.description: Keeps LLM work scoped to the current git branch: injects a branch scope context file (.pi/branches/<branch>.md) into the prompt and gates out-of-scope implementation work behind a blocking user choice dialog.
